subject: Capacity sprint & tentative GPU lock — Edgewave POC -> prod ramp
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Park <alice.park@edgewave.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-12-02T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Capacity sprint & tentative GPU lock — Edgewave POC -> prod ramp

Hi Alice,

Great conversation yesterday — thanks for the clarity on your production timeline. To keep momentum for the Edgewave POC -> production ramp, we'd like to propose a short capacity sprint / soft-hold so we can guarantee predictable latency and throughput while you finalize the launch cadence.

Summary (proposal):
- Initial reserved posture: 8 x NVIDIA A100 80GB (fp16) for initial prod window (target go-live: mid-Jan).
- Ramp posture (post-PoC): up to 12 x A100 80GB for month 2-3 of launch; programmatic burst to 16 x if you hit planned demand thresholds.
- Region preference: us-west-2 (primary), fallback us-east-1.
- Hold window requested: 90 days (soft-hold; nonbinding for billing until contract addendum).
- Acceptance criteria we need from Edgewave: 95th percentile token latency target, expected avg sequence length, and the model variant you plan to pin (openmodel-v3-large / customer-finetuned v1).

Attached is a rough cost/sizing workbook I ran through with infra (fleet_sprint_estimates.xlsx). If you can confirm model/seq length by Friday we will lock the soft-hold and map to a hold ID so Ops can earmark capacity.

Ask: please confirm (a) the model variant + avg seq length, (b) that a 90 day soft-hold is acceptable while we finalize the addendum, and (c) rough weekly token volumes for the first 8 weeks.

If that looks good, I'll loop in Ben to do the inventory check and create the soft-hold ticket.

Thanks — excited to keep this moving.

--
Soojin Lee
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0132

Attachment: fleet_sprint_estimates.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-12-02T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Capacity sprint & tentative GPU lock — Edgewave POC -> prod ramp

Soojin / Karthik,

Thanks — I pulled a quick inventory snapshot this morning and attached it. Short summary from Infra ops: we have limited A100-80GB availability in us-west-2 for mid-Jan -> end-Mar due to other reserved commitments. That said, we can create a soft-hold (non-billable) to earmark nodes while contracts are finalized.

Notes and risks:
- Current workable configuration: 8 x A100-80GB in us-west-2 available for a soft 90-day block if we accept a canary of 2 nodes for the first week (to validate perf).
- If Edgewave requires strict pinning to physical hosts, there may be a 2–3 week provisioning lag.
- Alternate option: 12 x an A100-80GB equivalent mix (8 A100 + 4 quantized A100 q8) with a routing policy that sends high-SLA traffic to the full-precision pool. This reduces provisioning pressure.
- Ops ticket: OPS-8241 will be the workspace to track the hold. I put a placeholder attachment: gpu_inventory_snapshot-20291202.pdf.

Please confirm: model variant + p95/p99 latency SLOs and whether Edgewave will accept a 2-node canary for week 1. Once confirmed, I'll create the soft-hold HLD record and add the earmark to the inventory ledger.

--
Ben Carter
Head of Capacity Planning, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: gpu_inventory_snapshot-20291202.pdf (pdf)

From: Alice Park <alice.park@edgewave.com>

Date: 2029-12-02T13:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Capacity sprint & tentative GPU lock — Edgewave POC -> prod ramp

Thanks Karthik / Soojin — appreciate the clear plan.

We accept the proposed posture: initial 8 x A100-80GB, ramp to 12x in month 2, with programmatic bursts to 16x as specified. We can tolerate a 2-node canary for the first week; acceptance criteria: p95 token latency < 120ms, and model pinned to edgewave-open-v1 for the first release.

I've attached our weekly forecast and the CSV with estimated token volumes. We will sign a 3-month reserved capacity addendum; please send DocuSign and the hold ID so we can reference it in procurement.

Attachment: Edgewave_Monthly_forecast.csv (csv)

Regards,
Alice Park

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Capacity Ops <ops@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-12-03T15:40:00-08:00
Subject: ACTION: create soft-hold for Edgewave (follow-up and runbook)

Ben / Ops — following Alice's confirmation, please action the soft-hold and inventory earmark:

Requested hold details (finalized):
- Hold ID: HLD-5342 (please confirm if an alternate internal id will be used).
- Customer: Edgewave / DEAL-19821-edgewave
- Nodes: 12 x A100-80GB (place 8 as primary reserved, 4 as quantized fallback if full-precision not available).
- Region: us-west-2 preferred; failover to us-east-1.
- Canary: 2 nodes live-test for 7 business days starting at provisioning + traffic smoke tests.
- Soft-hold window: 2029-12-06 to 2029-03-06 (90 calendar days).
- SLO: p95 token latency < 120ms for the canary; escalate to Soojin/Karthik if we miss by >20% for two consecutive days.

Operational asks:
1) Create OPS ticket and attach gpu_inventory_snapshot-20291202.pdf and fleet_sprint_estimates.xlsx. Link the ticket to OPS-8241 and the DocuSign placeholder: https://docusign.com/edgewave/agreements/DS-89271.
2) If A100-80GB nodes are not available for physical pinning, apply the mixed-pool routing (8 full-precision + 4 q8) and annotate the trade-offs in the ticket.
3) Notify sales once the soft-hold is active and provide the hold reference and expected provisioning ETA.

Quote: "We can create a soft-hold (non-billable) to earmark nodes while contracts are finalized." — Ben Carter 2029-12-02 10:05

Please confirm when completed. If infra needs a different date window to align with other commitments, flag now — Edgewave needs the guarantee before end of week to align procurement.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
